about.title: Calexico Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a fatal collision happens on a Calexico roadway, whether along Rt 98, Cesar Chavez, or a quieter residential street, the people left behind face grief alongside a maze of legal and financial questions. California law allows a spouse, domestic partner, or children to pursue a wrongful death claim first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. These cases are separate from any criminal charges that may follow a fatal crash and focus instead on compensating the family for what was lost. LawProactive is not a law firm; we're a free service that connects grieving families in Calexico with an independent personal injury attorney who can review the circumstances of the death and explain what options may exist. There's no cost to speak with someone, and any attorney in our network works on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. You don't have to sort through this alone.

whyChoose.title: What Families in Calexico Should Know

items.title: Only Certain People Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in a wrongful death case to a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in some cases. An attorney can help determine who qualifies to bring the claim.

items.title: The Clock Starts Running Quickly
items.desc: Families generally have two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim in California, though claims against a government entity involve a much shorter window. Acting sooner rather than later preserves your options.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond Funeral Costs
items.desc: California law recognizes recoverable losses like funeral and burial expenses, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. An attorney can help make sure all of these are accounted for.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in Calexico under California law?
items.answer: A surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have first priority to file. If none exist, certain other dependents or heirs may be eligible depending on the circumstances. An independent attorney can review your family's situation and clarify who has standing.

items.question: How much time do we have to file after a fatal crash on a road like Cole Road or Cesar Chavez?
items.answer: In most cases, California gives families two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If a government entity, such as a public road authority, may be involved, that deadline can be much shorter. It's worth speaking with an attorney early to avoid missing any filing window.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to any criminal case against the other driver?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action from any criminal charges that may be filed. The civil case focuses on compensating the family for their losses, while a criminal case, if any, addresses punishment under the law. The two can proceed independently of one another.
